Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (dedicated / VPC options)

Hi Leah —

Thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap from my side and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Primary need: low-latency, high-throughput inference for real-time analytics (90ms p50 target), with strict data separation for some regulated pipelines.
- Current stack: internal feature store + Kafka, batch jobs running on CPUs today.
- Timeline preference: exploratory pilot in the next 6–12 weeks if procurement and security checks go smoothly.

Recommended paths (we discussed three):
1) Hosted API (fastest): minimal up-front work, good for proofs-of-concept, pay-as-you-go.
2) Dedicated (reserved GPU pools): predictable throughput, good if you want consistent latency at scale.
3) Private / VPC (customer network & private control plane): best for regulated data and auditability — requires network setup and SOW but gives strongest isolation.

Proposed immediate next steps
- I’ll attach a short mutual action plan that maps milestones (pilot scope, security checklist, PO/SOW).
- Please confirm which deployment path you want us to prioritize (hosted vs dedicated vs private/VPC). If VPC/private looks appealing, we can schedule a 30–45min ops checklist with Marcus to capture networking and KMS needs.
- If procurement wants ballpark numbers, we can provide a two-slide cost summary for a 3-month pilot.

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_StellarMetrics.pdf (one-page MLP)

Would love a quick reply indicating priority/timing so we can line up resources.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
